sources.title: LightOnOCR-3-0.8B exact checkpoint model card
sources.evidence: Identifies the smallest LightOnOCR-3 model, Apache-2.0 release, Qwen3.5 VLM architecture, image/text prompts and text outputs. Supports empty-prompt transcription and grounding; other instructions are out of distribution. It was trained and evaluated with thinking disabled. Examples set 1,024 or 4,096 new output tokens. Reopened October 27: the card identifies the Qwen3.5 architecture but does not name Qwen3.5-0.8B as its base checkpoint or define active parameters.

sources.title: LightOnOCR-3-0.8B exact checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration; 24 decoder layers (18 linear attention, six full attention), hidden size 1,024, dense MLP width 3,584, vocabulary 248,320 and tied embeddings. Vision encoder has 12 layers, width 768 and output width 1,024. max_position_embeddings is 262,144; no quantization configuration or MTP layers.

sources.title: Original BF16 checkpoint tensor header
sources.evidence: Read only byte ranges 0-7 and 8-58687; both returned HTTP 206. The 58,680-byte JSON header describes 473 BF16 tensors totaling 852,985,920 learned parameters: text 752,393,024, vision encoder excluding merger 88,004,352, vision merger/projector 12,588,544. No separately stored lm_head, quantization metadata, or rotary buffers. No weight payload was downloaded.

sources.title: Qwen3.5 reference implementation, Transformers v5.5.4
sources.evidence: Implementation version recorded by the checkpoint: dense gated MLPs, Gated DeltaNet linear-attention blocks and gated full-attention blocks, vision transformer and learned merger. lm_head aliases the text embedding; A_log and dt_bias are learned parameters. Rotary inv_freq/original_inv_freq are non-persistent buffers and absent from the checkpoint header.

sources.title: LightOnOCR-3: High-Performance OCR and Layout Extraction in One Model
sources.evidence: Official October 8, 2026 release article, reopened October 27. Tables list this exact variant at nominal Size (B) 0.8, without an active column. Says the 0.8B/4B variants adopt Qwen3.5 architecture; explicitly identifies Qwen3.5-4B as the 4B variant base, but supplies no corresponding named-base statement for 0.8B. Describes SFT and GRPO without a separate active count or this variant's training sequence length.

sources.title: LightOnOCR official serving guidance
sources.evidence: Exact 0.8B entry recommends 2,048-pixel page longest edge, a serving max-model-len of 18,000 and disabled thinking. This operational total sequence limit is distinct from the checkpoint positional capacity and an output-only token cap.

sources.title: Official model repository metadata
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: public, ungated repository remains at 36d8636925327c671bd8e479c517a004f7566bd9, last modified October 9, 2026. Hub safetensors metadata still reports 852,985,920 BF16 elements, corroborating the previously verified unique-parameter total. Card metadata has no named base-model relationship. No weights or headers were downloaded during this re-audit.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint inherited chat template
sources.evidence: Default generation prefix closes an empty thinking block; thinking can be enabled syntactically. Template contains tools and video branches inherited from the underlying VLM. Those code paths alone do not establish supported OCR fine-tune capabilities beyond the card's two prompt modes.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-0.8B official model card: language-model scope
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. Model overview places the nominal 0.8B count specifically under Language Model, followed by decoder dimensions and multi-step MTP training. Does not define a separate active count. This scoped Qwen specification alone cannot replace the complete LightOnOCR checkpoint total or establish its active count.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-0.8B official configuration compared with OCR checkpoint
sources.evidence: Main decoder and vision dimensions match LightOnOCR-3-0.8B: 24 decoder layers, width 1024, FFN 3584, tied 248320-token embeddings; 12 vision layers, width 768, FFN 3072 and output width 1024. Qwen config has one MTP layer whereas OCR has zero. This difference does not itself define nominal active participation; no count is inherited from architecture similarity.

sources.title: LightOnOCR-3 original interactive benchmark size plot
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. Exact LightOnOCR-3-0.8B point has size 0.8 on an axis labeled Model parameters (B); method says table counts include nominal backbone sizes where specified. Neither plotted data nor accompanying table labels these as active parameters.

sources.title: Open-source OCR models on OmniParseBench, October 23, 2026
sources.evidence: Original model-research-team benchmark table identifies LightOnOCR-3-0.8B with 0.85B in its parameters column, consistent with the complete 0.85298592B count at rounded precision. The table has no active column; its parameter axis includes the 35.1B full-size Infinity-Parser2-Pro MoE entry. This is comparison-team corroboration, not a LightOn active-count disclosure.

sources.title: Jina-ocr-v1 original research-team comparison with active-parameter columns
sources.evidence: Original OCR comparison Table 1 separately lists total and active parameters, including LightOnOCR-2-1B at 1B total and 596M active. It does not identify LightOnOCR-3-0.8B. The predecessor entry cannot establish an active convention for this different Qwen3.5-based variant.

sources.title: LightOnOCR paper linked by the current OCR3 model card
sources.evidence: Current linked paper is version 2, revised June 30, 2026, describing LightOnOCR-2-1B. It predates OCR3 and supplies no exact OCR3-0.8B active count or named Qwen3.5-0.8B lineage statement.

sources.title: LightOnOCR-3 official research landing page
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. The exact 0.8B variant appears in developer benchmark data at nominal 0.8B model parameters. No distinct active-parameter definition or exact named-base relationship is provided.

sources.title: Exact model repository discussion: Base models release
sources.publisher: Hugging Face community discussion in LightOn repository
sources.evidence: Checked as a lineage lead. The only comment is a non-LightOn user asking for the pre-RL/post-SFT checkpoint; no developer reply identifies an upstream base checkpoint or provides parameter counts. Not treated as developer evidence.

name.note: Catalog display spacing corresponds to the official LightOnOCR-3-0.8B checkpoint name.

developer.note: Published by LightOn through its lightonai organization.

family.note: The developer explicitly groups this exact variant in the LightOnOCR-3 family.

release_date.note: Explicit first-party release announcement. October 7 repository creation and October 9 current checkpoint revision are not substituted for announcement/public-release evidence.

open_weights.note: The official original BF16 checkpoint is publicly accessible without gating.

license.note: Exact model card and release announcement specify Apache License 2.0.

parameters_b.note: Retain the previously verified complete unique learned-parameter total, 0.85298592B, at unchanged revision 36d8636925327c671bd8e479c517a004f7566bd9. October 27 Hub metadata still reports 852,985,920 BF16 elements. Existing breakdown remains 752,393,024 text + 88,004,352 vision encoder + 12,588,544 merger/projector; tied output head counted once. LightOn separately publishes nominal 0.8B, and Datalab's October 23 comparison reports rounded 0.85B. Qwen's nominal language-model count is component-scoped and does not supersede this complete total. No census was rerun.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 search found no separately defined active count for this exact variant. LightOn tables/plot give nominal size; the newer Datalab table gives 0.85B parameters without an active column. Jina/Elastic's explicit active column covers LightOnOCR-2-1B, not OCR3-0.8B. LightOn documents Qwen3.5 architecture but no exact Qwen3.5-0.8B base relationship was found in its card, release, landing page, linked paper or repository discussion. Configs match main decoder and vision dimensions but differ in MTP layers (OCR 0, Qwen 1); that difference alone neither disproves a shared nominal convention nor establishes one. Qwen's card also lacks a separate active count. Neither the complete total nor the 0.752393024B text component is substituted for an undocumented active convention.

architecture.note: Dense Qwen3.5 vision-language model: 12-layer vision transformer, learned patch-merger/projector and 24-layer decoder with 18 Gated DeltaNet linear-attention blocks plus six gated full-attention blocks and dense SwiGLU MLPs. No expert routing. This is not the Mistral/Pixtral-based LightOnOCR-2/LightOnOCR-3-1B architecture.

context_window.note: Retain as configured maximum positional capacity, not a verified OCR training length or demonstrated input-only allowance. Official serving guidance uses 18,000 total sequence tokens. Card generation examples cap new output at 1,024 or 4,096 tokens; those are request settings, not architectural context or a universal maximum output. The examined first-party training discussion does not disclose the exact OCR3-0.8B training length.

modalities.note: Supported OCR usage accepts a page image plus an optional text prompt and returns transcription/layout text. Inherited video placeholders are not sufficient evidence of trained video OCR support.

reasoning.note: The OCR checkpoint is expressly trained and evaluated with thinking disabled; template syntax for enabling thinking does not establish a supported reasoning mode.

tool_call.note: No supported tool-calling task: the developer limits supported instructions to empty-prompt transcription or grounding and labels other instructions out of distribution. The inherited template can serialize tools but does not establish tool-call training or support.

description.value: Vision-language model for page transcription, document layout extraction, image descriptions and chart-to-table conversion.
description.note: Describes supported transcription and grounding outputs from the exact model card without comparative claims.

patch.notes: Complete checkpoint: 852,985,920 parameters; developer nominal size: 0.8B. The count includes text, vision and projection components, with tied embeddings counted once. Active parameters are not separately specified for this variant. Dense Qwen3.5 vision-language architecture. Context 262,144 is configured positional capacity; official OCR serving guidance uses 18,000 total sequence tokens. OCR training length and long-context quality at 262,144 are unestablished. Thinking is disabled for the trained OCR task; supported prompts are empty or grounding.
patch.description: Vision-language model for page transcription, document layout extraction, image descriptions and chart-to-table conversion.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit preserves the verified 0.85298592B complete checkpoint total and the developer's nominal 0.8B designation. Current Hub metadata confirms the same revision and count; the October 23 Datalab comparison corroborates rounded 0.85B. Active parameters remain undisclosed after checking current LightOn sources, original benchmark tables/plot, Qwen card/configuration and the Jina/Elastic active-count comparison (which names the predecessor only). No exact named-base relationship or applicable active convention supports inheritance. All other 12 field assessments and the existing component breakdown are preserved; no weights or headers were downloaded.
